construction.name: prism_envelope_antiprism_ring_slots
construction.proof:
WHOLE PRISM ENVELOPE TO ANTIPRISM RING/SLOT COMPOSITION

Take a complete native source of canonical regular p-prisms of height h, with centers c_i and actual rational proper frames R_i. Retain every full source owner and source provenance. The target is canonical q-antiprism, full height H, whose two horizontal rings together project to a regular 2q-gon of radius R_q.

Let L=lcm(p,2q). The source facet normal angles form a p-grid and the projected target vertex angles a 2q-grid. Their differences form an L-grid. Choose the ONE canonical phase theta=arg(n_0)-arg(v_0)+pi/L (mod 2pi/L), so every source facet lies midway between two nearest points of the difference grid. Then max over all source normals/target vertices of cos angular difference is cos(pi/L). This proves the concentric whole projected target lies in alpha times the source base when alpha >= R_q*cos(pi/L)/a_p, where a_p is the source apothem. No optimized angle or frame approximation is inferred from a metric search.

For k complete target children per source, require alpha*h >= k*H. Put child (i,j) at alpha*c_i + R_i((j-(k-1)/2)*H*e3), j=0..k-1, with frame R_i Q_theta. Every child lies inside the same uniformly scaled complete parent; siblings have disjoint open axial intervals, and different parents inherit the original complete parent separation. The inverse decoder is (parent index i, axial slot j). Both axial signs of an arbitrary frame are respected by R_i e3; there is no common-axis hypothesis.

The source inequality proves this at the exact forced phase. A native implementation will choose a declared rational quaternion lift close to that single phase and recheck ALL actual source facet/target vertex inequalities with outward intervals, selecting a rational alpha no smaller than that actual containment requirement and k*H/h. All centers and all common cube wall costs are evaluated from the transformed actual child vertices. A common center/host dilation restores binary64 rounding; both inherited cross-parent and sibling separators and actual final native checks are mandatory.

First screen only actual retained/current prism parents with count n and k*n<=100 against current full public/private/pending AP cube gates. Preserve known-nominal certificate classification. The screen is only a proposal; full canonical containment and physical native decoding are required before claiming a gain. No antiprism record follows merely from a circular radius or volume inequality.

construction.name: complete_mixed_axis_prism_layer_return
construction.proof:
COMPLETE MIXED-AXIS LAYER COMPOSITION

Continue the rectangular-column construction by retaining its complete
box, but allow the three cyclic coordinate frames. These are fixed proper
120-degree rotations about the (1,1,1) axis, not variable prism angles.

For an owner box with side lengths d0,d1,d2, a layer of type k has complete
height dk and contains floor(S/di)*floor(S/dj) whole cells, where i,j are
the two other coordinates. An integer word (L0,L1,L2) composes those
layers with total height L0*d0+L1*d1+L2*d2. It fits the SAME cube when
that sum<=S. The number of owners is the sum of the three layer counts
times their actual in-layer capacities. All layers use common transverse
cube walls, and adjacent layers share their full horizontal boundary.
Deleting named whole cells yields any smaller count. This is a complete
physical decoder; an independent per-layer enclosing scale is never used.

The finite probe considers transverse events S=m*di, which determine the
three layer capacities, and enumerates integer layer words whose total
height is below the current comparison bound. For each word the actual
common side is max(transverse_event,total_height). Thus every tested
state is a concrete guillotine composition before any comparison is made.
The best among these states is only a result for this compositional family,
not a general packing bound. Retain all controls and source words.

Native witnesses use three fixed numeric quaternions. Outward interval
boxes are recomputed for each quaternion; common rational axis lengths
are rounded upward enough to contain the corresponding cyclic boxes.
The full layer word, grid words, every center and the shared cube are
retained, so rounding or a changed quaternion cannot silently alter a
boundary cost. The exact cell proof then applies to all whole owners.
construction.native_decoder: Place layer types 0,1,2 in that order from z=-total_height/2. Each type k has full thickness W[k], cyclic quaternion[k], and transverse grid counts from its intrinsic-axis permutation. Each owner center is the cell midpoint minus its own rigorous box midpoint. Retain precisely the listed owner words. Round centers once to binary64 and host scale upward.
construction.pair_rule: Different layers separate in z; within one layer the first distinct grid coordinate separates complete owner cells.

canonical_inclusion.scope: The exact geometric phase follows the regular p/2q difference-grid law. No correctly-rounded transcendental or exact algebraic phase is claimed.

construction.inverse_decoder: Undo stored center rounding error, divide by rho, add midpoint, subtract R_source times local slot offset, and divide by alpha. contribution.method:
This batch contains 23 fresh campaign cases, distinct from all 54 earlier fresh archives: 19 antiprism cases, three prism cases and one pentakis-dodecahedron self-packing. Sixteen improve the pinned current nominal/reference bound; seven improve complete native certificates without claiming a new ideal nominal value.

The main new construction places fixed-phase antiprism rings and whole axial slots inside actual complete regular-prism parents. The forced phase comes from the full cyclic difference grid. Every child, sibling slab and inherited parent separator is retained. Literal whole-owner prefixes give additional complete cases. For six hexagonal antiprisms in a cube, one common center contraction releases the artificial parent facets while all 15 target-pair separators remain simultaneously valid; the certified side is 2.862714781480716. No angle sweep is used.

A reciprocal golden-host inclusion and common return give eleven pentakis dodecahedra in their own host at 2.82404531854329. The three prism cases retain complete source-column and height/collar operations from the reviewed bank.

All active witnesses passed independent source, full geometry and current-public/private comparisons, followed by both official checks on the packaged native files. The archive preserves complete parent packings, physical decoders, common-return certificates and original source attribution. Some provenance audit scripts require the authenticated upstream Git snapshot or reviewed-source registry; the bundled official native validators are directly replayable.

Credit the new finite constructions exactly to PingYou Ltd. Original donors and their authors remain explicitly credited. These contributions may be published under the repository’s MIT license. No global optimality is claimed. Fresh campaign cases, live site credit and submission acceptance are tracked separately.
